input: # Version strings the specification itself uses as examples, grouped by
# where they appear. https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html — the group
# heading names the section, and a row belongs to the group above it.
# This is a selection, not an inventory: the specification also uses
# Versions the specification names elsewhere: 42.0.0 heads an FAQ
# question, 3.1.1 / 3.2.0 / 4.0.0 are the "Why Use Semantic Versioning?"
# firetruck example, 1.2.3 is the FAQ's "Is v1.2.3 a semantic version?".
